summary: Phase 3 Store Setup Wizard (9-step) verified end-to-end via Playwright. 9/10 TEST items PASS. Only finding: TEST 3 step-1 (store type) required-validation is effectively bypassed because Webstores.js initialises formData.store_type to 'business' (non-null). The wizard correctly blocks Next on missing name (Step 2) and missing owner_name (Step 3). All store types (business / fundraiser / creator / event) created successfully through the wizard, totals jumped 16 → 20 confirming POST /api/webstores/v2 contract is preserved. Existing 'Gala Test 2026 UI' event store unaffected, ribbon routes work.

minor.issue: Multiple console 500s on 'Error loading products: AxiosError' observed during page loads. Unrelated to Phase 3 wizard, but persistent in this preview env.

ui_bugs.issue: Step-1 required-validation does not actually block Next because formData.store_type defaults to 'business' in Webstores.js (line ~189 and ~377). Spec TEST 3 says 'click Next without selecting a type → must stay on Step 1'. Either set initial store_type to '' / null, or remove default. Validation for Step 2 (name) and Step 3 (owner_name) works correctly.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — add a <DialogDescription> to the create-webstore-dialog for accessibility.

action_items: Change default formData.store_type from 'business' to '' (or null) so Step 1 'pick a type' validation actually blocks Next per spec.
Add <DialogDescription> to create-webstore-dialog to clear the aria-describedby a11y warning.
Investigate /api/products 500 (unrelated to Phase 3 but noisy in console).
critical_code_review_comments: Webstores.js line 189 and 377 initialise formData.store_type='business'; this bypasses the wizard's own stepErrors.type guard since validation only fires on empty/falsy. Either change default to '' or change the wizard to require an explicit user click before allowing Next on step 1.

StoreSetupWizard.js correctly avoids product-level pricing fields (base/production/retail/setup/margin/markup). Shipping & Handling is correctly scoped store-level inside Step 6. Good adherence to Phase 3 rule.

Wizard footer disables submit only on Object.keys(stepErrors).some([type,name,owner_name]); since type default is 'business', submit is never blocked by missing type even if user back-navigates to step 1 and unsets — but UI has no way to unset (no clear button). Recommend explicit selection requirement instead of relying on default.

success_rate.backend: 100% (POST /api/webstores/v2 contract preserved — 4 new stores created, totals 16→20)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 TEST items pass; TEST 3 step-1 validation gap)

seed_data_creation: Created 4 stores via wizard with timestamp suffix: 'Phase3 Biz 1779642888', 'Phase3 Fund 1779642888', 'Phase3 Creator 1779642888', 'Phase3 Event 1779642888'. They appear in the All Stores table and persist after reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard data-testids used: wizard-stepper, wizard-pane-{type|basics|owner|branding|dates|fulfillment|questionnaire|payments|review}, wizard-{next|prev|submit|cancel}-btn, wizard-type-{business|fundraiser|creator|event}, wizard-name-input, wizard-owner-input, wizard-owner-email-input, wizard-sh-enabled-switch, wizard-review-summary, wizard-recommended-warnings. In the All Stores table, settings/gear icon is the 2nd-to-last button (-2 index) in the row — the last button is the trash/delete icon. To open store detail use that gear button. To bypass occasional Sign In click flakes, use page.locator('input[type=password]').press('Enter').
rca_of_the_issue: TEST 3 step-1 gap: Webstores.js initialises formData.store_type='business'. When the dialog opens the wizard's stepErrors.type guard never fires (value is truthy). Fix: initialise store_type to '' (and the matching reset block at line ~377). The wizard already shows the type chooser correctly and writes the user's selection back into formData.store_type.
